fit: topical extra-virgin oil and PSQI in dialysis patients
assessment: The local thesis extract records 42 oil and 39 saline participants versus 86 planned. Adjusted four-week PSQI changes were −2.863 and +0.126 within arms. No direct between-arm coefficient is reported in the table. The oil was applied to itchy skin.
